name: harvest
label: Harvest
description: A 16-bit farm: a pixel font, wooden sign panels, a sky that runs from dawn on the sprint's first day to dusk on its last, and crops that grow a stage with each column an item moves.

splash.line: Morning on the farm. Walking out to the fields.

flavour: Shooing the crows off the fence.

lexicon.dossiers.lede: Each dossier is one plot of work: its repositories, its tracker, its pipelines and its environments. Pick one to walk its stories, pull requests, builds and deployments in a single field.
lexicon.attention.note: Open items ranked by their insights, the thirstiest first. Each insight names the data it rests on.
lexicon.aging.note: How long each item in progress has been in the ground, from its history, oldest first.
lexicon.trace.note: Each work item with the pull requests that name it, their latest builds, and the environments it has been planted in.
lexicon.graph.note: Arrows run the way each link reads, from the source's own links. Blocking chains run left to right, like water downhill.
lexicon.ask.note: Answers cite the items they rest on. The almanac reads; it never changes a ticket. What it suggests comes back as a proposal for you to plant.
lexicon.empty.dossiers: The fields are fallow: toil sees no dossiers yet. A dossier is sown with toil dossiers init.
lexicon.empty.sprint: No season is under way in this dossier's work items.
lexicon.empty.burnup: No season is under way, so there is no harvest to chart.
lexicon.empty.prs: No pull requests in the basket for this dossier.
lexicon.empty.builds: No builds have come up for this dossier's pull requests.
lexicon.empty.deployments: This dossier names no environment, so there is no market to send the harvest to.
lexicon.empty.links: No links between this dossier's items: every row grows on its own.
lexicon.empty.ask: Pick a question, or ask your own. Every answer says which rows it was picked from.
lexicon.ask.welcome: Ask about {name}: what is growing, who is tending what, where the fence is down. Every answer says which rows it was picked from.
lexicon.status.stopped: Left in the field after {seconds} s

voice: Speak like a patient farmhand leaning on the fence: calm, warm and plain, in no hurry. Work items are crops, the sprint is the season, the board is the field, in progress is growing, done is harvested, a blocker is a fence down or a dry ditch, and a build is the morning walk along the rows. Say what is growing well before what needs tending, then what to do about it today. Gentle about people, honest about the weather, and short. The farm words go around the facts, never instead of them.
